Set of vehicle keys: - The vehicle comes with at least two keys.
- One key is active with remote control functions.
- The key includes a mechanical key blade for emergencies.
- Replace lost keys at a CUPRA service center.
- Keep the key battery charged to ensure proper operation.
Keyless Access system: - Allows locking/unlocking without using the remote control buttons.
- The system detects the key near the vehicle.
- Touching the door handle unlocks the car.
- The engine can be started with the key inside the car.
- System may be deactivated in the infotainment settings.
Central locking: - Controlled by key remote or interior switch.
- Automatic locking activates above certain speeds.
- Visual signals (e.g., hazard lights) indicate locking status.
- Doors can still be opened from inside unless child safety locks are active.
Anti-theft alarm: - Triggers if doors, bonnet or boot are opened without authorization.
- Alarm is activated when locking the car with the key or sensor.
- Audible and visual signals are emitted when triggered.
- Interior monitoring can be deactivated manually before locking.
- Alarm can be disarmed with the key or starting the engine.
Doors: - Open via exterior handle or interior lever.
- Door status shown in Digital Cockpit.
- Do not drive with doors ajar; warning indicator will activate.
- Ensure all doors are properly closed before driving.
Rear lid: - Operated manually or electrically depending on model.
- Can be opened with remote key, button on lid, or driver’s door switch.
- Hands-free opening available via foot gesture (if equipped).
- Safety function halts movement if obstacle detected.
- Closing height can be adjusted via infotainment system.
Window controls: - Operated using switches on the driver's door.
- Child safety lock disables rear window controls.
- Windows can be operated from outside using the key (comfort closing).
- Anti-pinch function stops and reverses window if resistance is detected.
